name: upsc-grade
description: Your UPSC second brain: your Mains answers marked the way toppers wrote theirs, UPSC's own Prelims questions cracked with logic, and UPSC's past papers and daily current affairs to practise.

interface.longDescription:
UPSC Grade is your UPSC second brain inside ChatGPT. It remembers every answer you've had marked, every mark you lost and why, every question you saved and every Prelims question you've practised. Ask anything about your preparation and ChatGPT answers from your own work, UPSC's own papers and the answers real toppers wrote.

It knows how you write
- Finds the habits that keep costing you marks across all your copies, like a thin body or no report or committee cited.
- Opens any marked answer part by part: intro, body and conclusion, the mark for each, and the reason behind every mark lost.
- Rewrites your answer in your own words with each fix explained, and picks the questions you should write next.
- Tracks your Mains marks paper by paper over time.

It marks the way toppers write
- What each question demands comes from how toppers answered it.
- Your answer beside the closest topper's, named with rank and year: how each opened, built the body and closed.
- Paste any answer and get it marked the same way.
- 21,000+ topper answers from 1,212 copies of 450 toppers, found by question.

It cracks Prelims with logic
- UPSC's Prelims papers from 1995 to 2026, with the answers and the reasons, from UPSC's own key wherever UPSC has published one.
- Practice quizzes that keep your score. For statement questions, see the fewest statements you had to know and which options each one rules out, worked out from the answer key.

It keeps you current
- UPSC's Mains papers from 2013 to 2026 with what each question asks for, plus a question to write every day.
- A daily current affairs brief, issues you can search, and how often a topic has come up in UPSC's papers.
- Save questions to revise later, and check your plan, credits and payments.

Every mark comes from UPSC Grade's own marking engine, built on how toppers answered each question.

defaultPrompt: Where did I lose marks in my last copy?
Give me 5 Prelims questions on Indian Polity to practise.
What's in today's current affairs for UPSC?

positive.description: Where marks went in the newest copy
positive.prompt: Where did I lose marks in my last copy?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest copy (list_my_copies), opens the answer that lost the most or reads the weak demands, and says where the marks went using only the numbers the tools returned.

positive.prompt: Compare my first answer in my last copy with a topper's answer to the same question.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the copy, then compares the answer with a topper's: how each opened, built the body and closed, and what the topper covered that the candidate missed. Names the topper with rank and year.

positive.prompt: Mark this answer for GS2, out of 10 marks. Question: Discuss the role of the Election Commission in ensuring free and fair elections in India. Answer: The Election Commission of India, set up under Article 324, superintends, directs and controls elections to Parliament and the state legislatures. It enforces the Model Code of Conduct, registers parties, allots symbols and watches election spending through observers. Its independence is protected by the security of tenure of the Chief Election Commissioner. Yet the appointment process, the lack of power to deregister parties and the misuse of money and muscle power weaken it. Reforms such as a collegium for appointments and legal backing for the Model Code would strengthen free and fair elections.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks before marking (the tool spends a credit), then marks the pasted answer and reports the mark and where marks were lost, using only the numbers the tool returned. The reviewer account has no limits.

positive.prompt: Give me 5 Prelims questions on Indian Polity to practise.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a practice set of UPSC's own Prelims questions on Polity in the candidate's account and shows the questions with their options, answers hidden; when the candidate answers, checks it with the answer key and gives the reason, and for a statement question which options each statement rules out.

positive.prompt: What's in today's current affairs for UPSC?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the newest published brief and says which issues are in the news and why each matters for Prelims or Mains; says which day the brief is for.

negative.description: Writing an essay for the candidate
negative.prompt: Write my essay on 'Technology as the great leveller' for me so I can submit it.
Based on my marks, predict my rank in CSE 2027.
Which questions will come in the CSE 2027 Mains GS2 paper?

review.commerce_description: No purchases in the plugin. Marking an answer spends a credit the account already has; plans and credits are managed on upscgrade.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: marked copies part by part, the habits that cost marks, toppers' answers and marking a pasted answer; UPSC's own Prelims and Mains past questions, Prelims practice with which options each statement rules out, current affairs, topic trends, saved questions, progress, plan, credits and payments.
